text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Espo-san. I heard you visited Funabashi 
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A friend mentioned it to me. They said you 
appeared quite accustomed to Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh... Is this from that test run?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Fell on your ass when you heard I got used 
to it so easily? Can't blame ya for 
wanting to think you had the edge on your 
own home turf.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Still, next time we meet in Funabashi—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Allow me to personally guide you 
through the culinary delights of 
Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A friend told me. They said that after 
your run, you were eating ankake yakisoba. 
...Smiling as you polished off a second 
and third helping, no less.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so glad. To think you've fallen in 
love with Funabashi too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Gahhh! T-That was just because I was 
starving!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Next time, we should definitely visit a 
place with great motsuni. Also, do you 
prefer your skewers with salt or tare 
sauce?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? The, the sauce flavor, damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As expected. ...Fufu. Funabashi is sure to 
satisfy your palate.
